tasks.title: Upgrade Astro and React Integrations
tasks.description: Ensure the Astro project and React integration are using the latest stable versions for optimal performance and compatibility.
tasks.details: Run '@astrojs/upgrade' to update Astro and all official integrations. Use 'npx astro add react' to ensure React is properly integrated. Confirm peer dependencies (react, react-dom) are at latest LTS versions. Update 'astro.config.*' and 'tsconfig.json' as needed.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify project builds and runs on localhost:4321. Check for deprecation warnings and integration errors in console.

tasks.title: Audit and Fix Portfolio Pages
tasks.description: Review all portfolio pages for broken links, missing assets, and rendering issues.
tasks.details: Use automated tools (e.g., Lighthouse, axe-core) and manual inspection to identify broken links, missing images, and layout problems. Fix issues directly in Astro/React components. Ensure all routes resolve correctly.
tasks.testStrategy: Run automated link and asset checks. Manually test navigation across all pages. Confirm all assets load without errors.

tasks.title: Implement Responsive Design Enhancements
tasks.description: Ensure the portfolio is fully responsive across devices and screen sizes.
tasks.details: Use CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS (latest v3.x) for utility-first responsive design. Audit existing styles for mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints. Refactor components to use responsive classes and media queries.
tasks.testStrategy: Test on Chrome DevTools device simulator and real devices. Validate layout and usability at multiple breakpoints.

tasks.title: Accessibility Compliance Audit & Fixes
tasks.description: Validate and improve accessibility across the portfolio and case studies.
tasks.details: Use axe-core and Lighthouse to audit for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance. Refactor components to use semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, and accessible navigation. Ensure keyboard and screen reader support for all interactive elements.
tasks.testStrategy: Run automated accessibility tests. Manually test with keyboard navigation and screen readers (NVDA, VoiceOver).

tasks.title: Optimize Performance & Core Web Vitals
tasks.description: Improve site speed, loading times, and Core Web Vitals metrics.
tasks.details: Leverage Astro's zero-JS-by-default philosophy. Use selective hydration for React components. Optimize images with Astro's built-in image tools. Implement code splitting and lazy loading for heavy components. Audit with Lighthouse and WebPageTest.
tasks.testStrategy: Run Lighthouse and WebPageTest audits. Confirm LCP, FID, CLS, and TTI are within recommended thresholds.

tasks.title: Verify Admin Backend Functionality
tasks.description: Test and validate the admin backend system for content management and smart uploads.
tasks.details: Access the admin server. Test smart upload features, content editing, and flow assignment. Ensure backend API endpoints are secure and functional. Use Postman or Insomnia for API testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform end-to-end tests on admin workflows. Validate API responses and error handling.

tasks.title: Design UX Flow Data Model
tasks.description: Define backend schema for serial UX flows and phase categorization.
tasks.details: Extend backend models to support UX phases (Problem, Research, Design, Implementation, Outcomes). Use a relational schema (e.g., PostgreSQL 15.x) or NoSQL (MongoDB 7.x) as appropriate. Include fields for flow steps, progress, and completion status.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for model validation. Test CRUD operations for flow entities.

tasks.title: Implement Flow-Based Content Categorization
tasks.description: Enable backend to categorize and manage case study content by UX phases.
tasks.details: Add endpoints and admin UI for assigning content to UX phases. Implement bulk assignment features. Ensure data integrity and synchronization with frontend.
tasks.testStrategy: Test phase assignment via admin UI and API. Validate categorization in database and frontend display.

tasks.title: Develop Accordion UX Flow Components
tasks.description: Create responsive, accessible accordion components for serial UX flows using React.
tasks.details: Use React 18.x and Headless UI (latest) for accessible accordions. Implement step-by-step navigation, progress indicators, and ARIA compliance. Integrate with Astro using selective hydration.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test accordion logic. Manually test accessibility and responsiveness. Validate integration in Astro pages.

tasks.title: Build Interactive Flow Visualizations
tasks.description: Develop interactive visualizations for UX process flows within case studies.
tasks.details: Use React with D3.js (v7.x) or Visx for process maps and progress indicators. Ensure smooth transitions and animations using Framer Motion (v10.x). Integrate with accordion components.
tasks.testStrategy: Snapshot and interaction tests for visualizations. Manual animation and transition validation.

tasks.title: Integrate Serial Flows into Case Studies
tasks.description: Inject serial flow components and visualizations into existing case study layouts.
tasks.details: Refactor case study templates to include accordion and visualization components. Ensure flows are dynamically loaded based on backend data. Maintain design system consistency.
tasks.testStrategy: End-to-end tests for case study rendering. Validate dynamic flow injection and data binding.

tasks.title: Implement Progress Tracking & Completion Indicators
tasks.description: Add progress tracking and completion indicators for UX flows in case studies.
tasks.details: Store progress state in backend and sync with frontend. Use React context or Redux Toolkit for state management. Display completion status and progress bars in UI.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit and integration tests for progress logic. Manual UI validation for indicator accuracy.

tasks.title: Connect Flows to Backend Content Management
tasks.description: Ensure frontend UX flows are fully synchronized with backend content management system.
tasks.details: Implement API calls for fetching, updating, and validating flow data. Use Axios (v1.x) or Fetch API. Handle errors and loading states gracefully. Secure endpoints with JWT or OAuth2.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests for API calls. Manual validation of data sync and error handling.

tasks.title: SEO & Meta Tag Optimization
tasks.description: Ensure all portfolio and case study pages have proper SEO and meta tags.
tasks.details: Use Astro's built-in SEO features and React Helmet (v6.x) for dynamic meta tags. Add Open Graph, Twitter Card, and canonical tags. Validate structured data for case studies.
tasks.testStrategy: Automated SEO audits (Ahrefs, Screaming Frog). Manual inspection of meta tags and structured data.

tasks.title: Final Testing, QA, and Documentation
tasks.description: Conduct comprehensive QA, finalize bug fixes, and produce documentation for the portfolio and serial flows.
tasks.details: Perform regression, usability, and cross-browser testing. Fix outstanding bugs. Write developer and admin documentation using MDX or Astro content collections. Prepare deployment checklist.
tasks.testStrategy: Full QA cycle. Peer review of documentation. Confirm all success criteria are met.
